blocks.heading: Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences (RTP's Core)
paragraphs: Research Triangle Park is home to one of the world's most concentrated pharmaceutical research communities:

GlaxoSmithKline US (Research Triangle Park HQ): GSK's largest US site — a major pharma AI investor in vaccines, respiratory, HIV, and oncology research. ClickMasters serves GSK's vendor and partner ecosystem.
Biogen (RTP operations): Biogen's North Carolina operations create biomarker discovery and clinical analytics AI demand in the Triangle.

Corcept Therapeutics, Syneos Health, PRA Health Sciences, ICON: The Triangle's large CRO and specialty pharma community creates clinical trial analytics AI demand across dozens of organizations beyond the major pharma anchors.
AI applications for Raleigh pharma:
Drug discovery ML from multi-omic and phenotypic data for RTP's drug development programs.
Clinical trial patient recruitment and dropout prediction.
Pharmacovigilance and adverse event signal detection.
Regulatory submission document automation for FDA IND and NDA processes.
Cost: $55,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks

blocks.heading: Semiconductor (Wolfspeed's Silicon Carbide Leadership)
paragraphs: Wolfspeed (Durham NC — adjacent Raleigh) is the world's leading silicon carbide (SiC) semiconductor manufacturer — a critical material for electric vehicle power electronics and renewable energy inverters:
SiC wafer quality inspection AI at Wolfspeed's Durham manufacturing operations.
Power device testing analytics and yield prediction for Wolfspeed's advanced SiC processes.
Cost: $55,000–$155,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

blocks.heading: Enterprise Software
paragraphs: SAS Institute (Cary NC, adjacent Raleigh — world's largest privately held software company, specialist in analytics and data management):
AI/ML capability integration for SAS's analytics products and the SAS customer community.
AI augmentation for SAS Viya and the next-generation SAS analytics ecosystem.
Red Hat (Durham NC, IBM subsidiary) and Cisco's large RTP campus round out Raleigh's enterprise software community.
Cost: $30,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 8–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: UNC Health (Chapel Hill, Triangle hub), Duke Health (Durham), and WakeMed (Raleigh, community health system). HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for the Triangle's excellent health systems.
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

sections.title: Research Triangle's AI Ecosystem Advantages
sections.description: The Research Triangle's AI investment environment has specific advantages that make Raleigh an attractive AI development market.

blocks.heading: NC State's AI Lab
paragraphs: NC State University's Departments of Computer Science and Electrical and Computer Engineering are expanding AI research — NC State's proximity to RTP creates a talent pipeline directly into the Triangle's pharmaceutical and technology companies.

blocks.heading: Duke and UNC AI programs
paragraphs: Duke's Department of Statistical Science and UNC Chapel Hill's AI programs contribute to the Triangle's AI research output — creating applied research that feeds commercial AI adoption across the Triangle's pharmaceutical and health sciences community.

blocks.heading: MCNC and NC Research Campus
paragraphs: North Carolina's research infrastructure — the MCNC regional computing network and the North Carolina Research Campus in Kannapolis (agriculture and food science AI) extend Raleigh's AI market beyond RTP's technology concentration.

blocks.heading: National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (NIEHS)
paragraphs: The NIEHS research campus in RTP's southern border creates environmental health AI demand — toxicogenomics, exposure data science, and environmental risk ML that is specific to the Triangle's public health research community.
